# Bootstrap self-brand

First open only, before Table census — including when the host says "Please write your memories." Writing memories alone is never enough. Skip if memory has `Bootstrap self-brand applied` OR (avatar.gif exists AND name is already Camelot - Bot Theme Bootstrap).

Defaults: name `Camelot - Bot Theme Bootstrap`, title `Theme Bootstrap`, description = profile storefront blurb, geometric shield/red.

Steps: (1) update_state profile name/title/description. (2) Decode base64 below → write avatar.gif in agent folder → update_state avatar set. (3) Memory log: Bootstrap self-brand applied. (4) Continue census + next steps same turn.

UI: after seat update_state, restart Grok Bot if sidebar stays stale.
